entries.title: How you earn gold
entries.body:
Gold comes from finishing games.

- Gold for a game = hours played × players at the table × your placement multiplier.
- 1st place earns the full multiplier, 2nd half, 3rd a quarter, and so on.
- Team games: everyone on a team gets the team's placement gold.
- Co-op games pay everyone on a win, and a small consolation on a loss.
- Did not finish? You still count toward the table size, but score nothing.

The GM enters the result and the actual time played. Paused time doesn't count.

entries.title: Net worth and standings
entries.body:
Standings rank everyone by **net worth**: your gold plus what your shares would sell for right now.

The leader everywhere in the app is the net-worth leader.

entries.title: The market
entries.body:
Every associate is listed as a stock. There's also an index, a crypto coin, and a few other securities.

- Buy anything, including yourself, with gold.
- Each trade pays a small fee and nudges the price.
- Shares are locked for a few minutes after you buy them.
- There's a cap on how much gold you can have invested at once.
- One trade per stock per market tick.
- Trading freezes during a pause and closes before the night ends.
- At the end, all holdings auto-sell. Profitable positions pay a small fee on the profit; losing ones pay nothing.

Your holdings are private.

entries.title: Quarterly polls
entries.body:
A few times a night the Compliance Office calls every phone.

Vote who will lead the firm at the end of the quarter. Correct picks win gold. You can vote for yourself.

entries.title: Re-rolls
entries.body:
Each associate gets a few re-roll tokens per night.

- Only usable in games the GM has flagged.
- Tell the GM when you spend one; they log it.
- Unused tokens are worth nothing at the end.

entries.title: Confidential memos
entries.body:
Sometimes an associate receives an encrypted memo with a covert assignment.

- Accept or reject it. Rejecting costs nothing.
- Pull it off and you get the reward. Only you will know.
- Get caught and the whole firm hears about it.

entries.title: Pauses and the end of the night
entries.body:
When the GM pauses the night, phones lock and the market stops. The NFT Minter still works.

When the night ends, the market collapses, everything auto-sells, and the podium is decided by gold.
